skills.name: Prose Polisher
skills.description: Elevate vocabulary, cadence, and elegance without losing your original voice.
skills.promptTemplate:
Please polish the following personal writing. Retain the core emotion and thoughts, but enhance the sentence flow, cadence, and vocabulary for literary quality:

"{text}"

skills.name: Grammar & Clarity Fixer
skills.description: Correct typos, punctuation, syntactic friction, and awkward sentence structures.
skills.promptTemplate:
Fix all grammatical mistakes, spelling errors, and punctuation flaws in the following text. Keep the tone natural and clear without changing the underlying meaning:

"{text}"

skills.name: Retrospective Extractor
skills.description: Extract key themes, emotional highlights, wins, and reflections from your journal entries.
skills.promptTemplate:
Analyze the following journal entry or notes. Extract: 1) Core Themes, 2) Key Emotional Highlights, 3) Notable Accomplishments/Wins, and 4) Actionable Insights for Tomorrow:

"{text}"

skills.name: Action Item Harvester
skills.description: Find implicit tasks, commitments, and deadlines buried in your reflections.
skills.promptTemplate:
Read through the text below and extract any concrete action items, pending tasks, or commitments. Format them as a concise checklist with suggested priorities (High/Medium/Low):

"{text}"

skills.name: Chapter Outliner
skills.description: Transform raw journal entries or story concepts into a structured book chapter.
skills.promptTemplate:
Transform the following notes or thoughts into a structured book chapter. Provide: 1) Chapter Title, 2) Narrative Arc Hook, 3) 3-4 Key Beats/Scenes, and 4) Closing Reflection:

"{text}"

skills.name: Poetic Metaphorist
skills.description: Reimagine thoughts through subtle metaphors, evocative imagery, and lyrical prose.
skills.promptTemplate:
Re-envision the following passage with poetic resonance. Use natural, contemplative imagery and subtle metaphors while keeping the emotional heart sincere:

"{text}"
